verdicts.tldr: No test passes an over-long signature or aggregate, so the native's refusal of sig||junk is unpinned while gnark itself ignores trailing bytes
verdicts.details: Every length case is short: sig[1:] at bls12381_test.go:76, aggregate[1:] at :201, agg[1:] at bls12381_test.gno:98, and gnark refuses each with io.ErrShortBuffer whatever the guard says. gnark v0.20.1 G2Affine.setBytes checks only len(buf) < SizeOfG2AffineCompressed and its compressed path reads buf[:fp.Bytes] and buf[fp.Bytes:fp.Bytes*2], so with != turned into < at bls12381.go:43 and :82 the Go suite stays green and sig||0x00 verifies as the same signature, which a realm deduplicating by signature bytes would take as a new update. Realms reach the native only through the wrapper, whose own != at bls12381.gno:37 and :65 still refuses, and any edit there moves the source-bytes root TestAppHashCrossrealm38 pins, though a hash bump clears that without checking behaviour; the loss needs both layers to regress. Fix: add require.False(t, X_fastAggregateVerify(pubkeys, msg, append(append([]byte{}, sig...), 0))) to the malformed-lengths subtest, the same with a trailing byte on aggregate and on sig for X_fastAggregateVerifyExcluding, and one FastAggregateVerify(pks, msg, vecSig+"00") case in bls12381_test.gno.

Mutation not run.

verdicts.tldr: No test repeats a key, so the valid sync-committee shape pk||pk, which only gnark's doubling branch keeps at 2pk, is unpinned
verdicts.details: signers() and committee() draw a fresh random scalar per member (bls12381_test.go:31-34, :137-140), the identity-aggregate case pairs a key with its negation (:89-95), and the Gno vectors are four distinct secret keys (bls12381_test.gno:9, :74). With pubkeys = pk||pk the accumulator at bls12381.go:57 holds pk with Z=1 when pk arrives again, and only gnark's p == a branch doubles it; the generic formula gives H = 0 and collapses the sum to the identity, which refuses a valid committee signature. The Altair spec's get_next_sync_committee returns the committee 'with possible pubkey duplicates'. The Excluding half as written does not reach that branch: agg(pk,pk,q) minus pk is 2pk+q-pk, a plain addition, so it pins duplicate-member semantics rather than the doubling. Fix: add require.True(t, X_fastAggregateVerify(pk||pk||q, msg, 2*sig_pk+sig_q)) and require.True(t, X_fastAggregateVerifyExcluding(2pk+q, pk||pk, msg, sig_q)).
verdicts.evidence: Read only. grep -n -i 'dup|twice|repeat|pubkeys\[0\]' over both test files: only bls12381_test.go:185, a signer appended once to excluded. gnark g1.go:459-462 `if U2.Equal(&p.X) && S2.Equal(&p.Y) { return p.DoubleMixed(a) }`; :446-451 copies a into an infinity accumulator with Z=1. consensus-specs master specs/altair/beacon-chain.md, get_next_sync_committee docstring: 'Return the next sync committee, with possible pubkey duplicates.', aggregate_pubkey = eth_aggregate_pubkeys(pubkeys). Vendored-gnark mutation not run.
verdicts.verify_by: grep both test files for a key appended twice (none: signers/committee draw fresh random keys, identity aggregate pairs key with its negation); add X_fastAggregateVerify(pk||pk, msg, 2*sig_pk) == true and X_fastAggregateVerifyExcluding(agg(pk,pk,q), pk, msg, sig_pk+sig_q) == true; replace g1.go's doubling check with a plain add in a vendored copy and watch only the new cases go red

verdicts.tldr: SKIP: whether any accepting vector pins the G2 compressed encoding against an independent implementation is not settled here
verdicts.details: The Go tests sign with gnark itself (bls12381_test.go:27-46, :133-152), bls12381_test.gno:9-10 and :74-75 name the secret keys but not the tool that produced vecSig and vecPartialSig, and no file in the full PR head references consensus-spec-tests; the only consumer, the bridge light client per clockworkgr's thread, is outside the PR. The parity half is largely covered already: an infinity pubkey at bls12381_test.go:78-83, and empty pubkeys refused by len(pubkeys) == 0 before the signature is decoded (:74, bls12381_test.gno:44). If vecSig came from an independent signer, its fixed bytes already pin gnark's G2 decoding and sign flag, since a wrong sign decodes -s and the pairing fails, and the gap closes. No py_ecc or blst exists on this machine to decide it. Confirm by signing 'gno.land bls12381 test vector' with secret keys 0x1234567, 0x89abcdef, 0x7654321 under py_ecc's G2ProofOfPossession and comparing with vecSig, or running consensus-spec-tests fast_aggregate_verify cases through X_fastAggregateVerify. Fix: if the vector proves gnark-made, add one consensus-spec-tests fast_aggregate_verify valid case as a fixed vector.

verdicts.tldr: The infinity-aggregate assertion holds on the signature mismatch alone, so the native's only refusal of an identity aggregate, at bls12381.go:86, is unpinned
verdicts.details: bls12381_test.go:205 passes the identity with excluded = pk2||pk5||pk11 and the 13-signer signature. Without || agg.IsInfinity(), SetBytes of the compressed infinity returns no error, FromAffine sets Z = 0, and AddMixed on a Z = 0 accumulator copies the point, so the signers sum to -(pk2+pk5+pk11), not the identity, and the pairing fails against the 13-signer signature: false with or without the guard. The wrapper checks lengths only (bls12381.gno:65) and bls12381_test.gno has no identity-aggregate case, so this guard is the only refusal; without it Excluding(identity, -pk_a, m, sk_a*H(m)) sums to pk_a and returns true, letting any key holder sign for a realm whose stored aggregate is the identity, a committee never initialised for one. Fix: add require.False(t, X_fastAggregateVerifyExcluding(ib[:], negPkA, msg, sigA)) with negPkA the encoding of -pk_a and sigA = sk_a*H(msg), true under the deletion and false at head.
verdicts.evidence: Read only. bls12381_test.go:205 `require.False(t, X_fastAggregateVerifyExcluding(ib[:], excluded, msg, sig))` with sig from committee(t, 16, ...) signed by the 13 non-absent members (:168). gnark g1.go:621-625 `if a.IsInfinity() { p.Z.SetZero() ...`; :446-450 `if p.Z.IsZero() { p.X = a.X; p.Y = a.Y; p.Z.SetOne()`. bls12381.gno:65 checks lengths only; bls12381_test.gno:84-101 holds no infinity aggregate. Deletion not run.

verdicts.tldr: No test feeds a repeated key, though Altair sync committees carry duplicate pubkeys and their aggregate sums every copy
verdicts.details: The only near-repeat is bls12381_test.go:185, where pubkeys[0], a signer, joins the excluded set once; the key helpers draw a fresh scalar per member (:31-34, :137-140) and the Gno vectors hold four distinct keys. The Altair spec returns the next sync committee with possible pubkey duplicates and computes aggregate_pubkey over every position, so a change that refuses repeated keys, or an adder losing gnark's p == a doubling, stays green while each update from a committee holding a repeated member is refused for that sync-committee period. Of the two proposed cases only the FastAggregateVerify one reaches the doubling; the Excluding one, 2pk+pk2 minus pk, pins duplicate-member semantics, the path the bridge uses per clockworkgr's thread. This is the same absence as candidate 14 and assembles into one finding. Fix: add require.True(t, X_fastAggregateVerify(pk||pk||pk2, msg, (2sk+sk2)*H(msg))) and require.True(t, X_fastAggregateVerifyExcluding(2pk+pk2, pk, msg, (sk+sk2)*H(msg))).
verdicts.evidence: Read only. grep -n -i 'dup|twice|repeat|pubkeys\[0\]' over bls12381_test.go and bls12381_test.gno: only bls12381_test.go:185. consensus-specs master specs/altair/beacon-chain.md: get_next_sync_committee_indices 'Return the sync committee indices, with possible duplicates, for the next sync committee.' gnark g1.go:459-462 doubling branch. Mutation not run.

verdicts.tldr: Deleting the wrapper's length guards does not ship green: TestAppHashCrossrealm38 pins bls12381.gno's source bytes in the genesis root, so the edit turns it red
verdicts.details: The read bears out the mechanism: the native repeats each condition (bls12381.go:43 and :82), so every malformed case still returns false, and chargeNativeGas charges Base plus Slope before the native runs, so only gas moves. But the full PR head's gno.land/pkg/sdk/vm/apphash_crossrealm38_test.go pins the multistore root that holds every stdlib's .gno sources, and its comment records three bumps for this package, the last for doc text alone, so any edit to bls12381.gno is a red test and a deliberate consensus change before it merges. What remains, no assertion on the gas of a malformed call, is too thin to post. Fix: none needed.
